capabilities: Search the current note with regex or plain-text patterns
Highlight all matches live while typing
Jump to next and previous matches
Select all matches as multiple cursors to replace them at once
Bind a custom hotkey to open the search bar
extras: Desktop only; not available on Obsidian mobile. Author tested on macOS only and asks users to open issues for Windows/Linux problems. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: No hotkey is bound by default. I recommend using Cmd/Ctrl+F, since that's where you'd normally reach for search
problem: Obsidian's built-in current-file search offers no regex pattern matching and no way to edit every match at once.
summary: In-note search bar that matches regex or plain-text patterns with live highlighting, next/previous navigation, and select-all-to-edit.
